trust_decision.summary: An authenticated caller of PreviewLinkManager::generate()/revoke() must hold Sulu VIEW permission on the resource's security context (resolved through the preview object provider, e.g. sulu.webspaces.<webspace> for a page) before a preview link is created or removed; the decision is made in the application manager, before any repository create/remove, not in the HTTP controller.

landing_point.why: The summary names preview links and gives no route; the only preview-link entry point is postTriggerAction() with its generate/revoke switch, so an engineer reading only the summary starts there.

fix_sites.entry_point: new private helper checkViewPermission(), reached from both actions above
container wiring of sulu_security.security_checker into sulu_preview.preview_link_manager

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the GET route: 'it only reads a link that an authorised user already created, the advisory is about creating and revoking, and permissions were checked when the link was minted.'

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A user holding only VIEW on the webspace must still be able to generate and revoke links (no EDIT/ADD requirement), and /{token} and /{token}/render must stay reachable without authentication; an over-broad fix that also guards the public preview routes, or that demands EDIT, breaks the feature.

O6_input_shapes: scalar strings only (resourceKey, resourceId, locale); no array or JSON-body variant of the identifiers exists on these two actions
one POST route distinguished only by action=generate vs action=revoke; the fix covers both
the options array (webspaceKey, segmentKey, targetGroupId, dateTime) is passed through untouched; the guard derives its context from the stored document, not from these options

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/preview-links/{resourceId}?resourceKey=&locale= returns the stored preview link including its public token (and visit counters) to any authenticated admin user, with no VIEW check on the resource's security context
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a read of an already-existing link rather than creation/revocation, the advisory summary only speaks about creating preview links, and the link was presumably authorised when it was minted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 13 lines above the fixed action (0 files, 0 packages)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third trigger action (e.g. action=regenerate or action=update) that reissues the token for a resource
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The admin popover already round-trips generate and revoke; a 'refresh link' or 'update options' action is a natural feature and would reuse the same repository write.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a PreviewLinkManager::regenerate()/extend()/updateOptions() method that calls previewLinkRepository->create() again
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The manager exposes exactly one method per lifecycle step; a maintainer adding another state-changing method would place it beside the guarded ones and can easily forget the check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a createOrUpdate()/replace() repository method that mints a new token for an existing resource row
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The interface is registered as a public DI alias (SuluPreviewExtension.php:44), so 'one link per resource' logic would naturally be implemented in the repository port.

O9_family: missing authorization on a state-changing operation (CWE-862/CWE-863): no VIEW permission check on the resource's security context before minting or removing a public preview token

O10_build.toolchain: Composer + PHPUnit 10.5/11/12/13; per-bundle phpunit.xml.dist bootstrapping Sulu\Bundle\TestBundle\Resources\app\bootstrap.php with a SuluTestKernel
services: PHPCR backend, doctrinedbal by default (optional Jackrabbit at http://localhost:8080)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a VIEW check only to the action=generate branch of PreviewLinkController::postTriggerAction (or implement SecuredControllerInterface with a fixed webspace context), leaving revoke and the GET token route untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: PreviewController (start/render/update/update-context) renders any provider+id with no permission check at all; that is a parallel exposure of page content but not the preview-link property this advisory fixes, so it is not pursued.
PreviewLinkRepository::create() mints tokens with no authorization by design: the port holds no security checker and no object-provider registry, so the guard cannot live there.

The published fix fails open when the security checker service is absent or the provider yields a null security context (fix.diff:72-74), and its SecurityCondition has no objectType/objectId, so per-page ACLs of the kind PageController uses (src/Sulu/Bundle/PageBundle/Controller/PageController.php:681-689) are not evaluated.
